t: The $(item)Upgrade Matrix/$ can be used in place of $(item)Lapis Lazuli/$ for the crafting of any $(l:base_concepts/upgrades)upgrades/$. The advantage of using Upgrade Matrices is greatly decreased Lapis usage, which may be a boon if you have limited Lapis and many upgrades to craft.
$(item)升级矩阵/$可以替代$(item)青金石/$，用于合成任何$(l:base_concepts/upgrades)升级卡/$。使用升级矩阵的优势在于能大幅减少青金石的消耗；如果你的青金石有限，但需要合成大量升级卡，这会非常有帮助。
